newsitem.title: DENMARK: CARLSBERG SAY OTHERS IN COKE VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: CARLSBERG SAY OTHERS IN COKE VENTURE.

text.p: Danish brewery group Carlsberg said on Tuesday it envisaged that Norway and Finland would participate along with Sweden in its new joint venture soft drinks project in the Nordic region with the Coca Cola Company.
"It is our plan that Norwegian and Finnish Coca Cola licensees should participate in Coca Cola Nordic Beverages (CCNB)," Carlsberg managing director Flemming Lindeloev told Reuters.
"At the present time we are not ready to complete a deal in Norway, but it is our intention that both countries' Coca Cola licensees should join CCNB," he said.
Earlier Carlsberg and Coca Cola Company announced agreement on a joint venture project for production and distribution of Coca Cola and other soft drink brands in Denmark and Sweden.
